english.title: Fail / neglect / refuse to comply with indication / PC / airport official / notice - Birmingham International Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person

(A)_[on foot]_
(B)_[driving or propelling a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

at Birmingham International Airport, neglected, failed or refused to comply with the indication or direction given by

(C)_[a constable]_
(D)_[an airport official]_
(E)_[a notice of Birmingham Airport Limited]_
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2.2 and 3.20 of the Birmingham Airport Limited Byelaws 2021.
